home_description: Gitflare is a fully open-source serverless git hosting platform. No VMs, No Containers, Just Durable Objects.
home_feature_serverless_desc: No servers to manage. Gitflare runs on Cloudflare's global network.
home_feature_durable_desc: Git repositories stored in SQLite via Durable Objects for reliability.
home_feature_open_source_desc: 100% open source. Self-host on your own Cloudflare account.
home_feature_fast_desc: Global edge network ensures low latency everywhere.
home_start_now_desc: Create your account and start hosting repositories in minutes.
home_footer: Gitflare. Built with Cloudflare Workers & Durable Objects.
home_tech_workers: To handle Git smart HTTP protocol requests and hosting the web interface.
home_tech_do: To store and manage Git repository data.
home_tech_d1: To store user data, repository metadata, issues, and other metadata.
home_tech_tanstack: As a framework for building the web interface.
